names-split-vs-combined.note: base has 姓/名 in two columns; the others have 氏名 with a full-width space, a half-width space, or no space

names-combined-vs-split.note: base has 氏名 (half-width space); others have 姓/名 columns (with kana columns), or 氏名 without a space

kana-scripts.note: フリガナ in katakana / hiragana / half-width katakana / without a space; the others carry NO kanji name

kana-split-vs-combined.note: base has セイ/メイ columns (+ 氏名); others have a combined フリガナ (hiragana / katakana) or 姓カナ/名カナ

english-name-orders.note: 'Taro Yamada' vs 'YAMADA Taro' vs 'Yamada, Taro' vs 'TARO  YAMADA' (double space, capitals)

name-variants-maiden.note: 髙橋/高橋, 渡邊/渡辺, 山﨑/山崎 (異体字 → joined, flagged), 斎藤/斉藤 (confusable → suggestion only), 旧姓（）, 読み仮名（） in parentheses

honorifics.note: 様 / さん / 殿 / 君 / さま / くん after the name

name-with-reading-line.note: 氏名 cells hold two lines: the kanji name and its フリガナ (LF / CR LF), or the reading in parentheses

split-name-header-variants.note: web-form headers 'お名前（姓）/お名前（名）' and 'セイ（カナ）/メイ（カナ）' against a base with 氏名 / フリガナ

english-split-columns.note: a one-column 'Taro Yamada' roster against 'Last Name / First Name' columns (capitals, any case)

name-hiragana-vs-katakana.note: 渡辺 さくら (hiragana given name) vs 渡辺 サクラ: the same person, but only a suggestion — the name key does not fold the scripts

homophone-surnames.note: 伊藤 花子 and 井藤 花子 share one フリガナ: the reading alone cannot say which of them answered

maiden-name-in-one-file.note: the base says 小林 花子（旧姓：加藤）, the other file 加藤 花子: the same person under the other surname — suggested, not joined

email-variants.note: the other file has ONLY e-mail addresses: capitals / trailing spaces / 全角＠ / mailto: / "名前 <addr>" / 。

files.fileName: アンケート_メールのみ.xlsx

phone-variants.note: the other file has ONLY phone numbers: hyphens / parentheses / +81 / 全角 / number without the leading 0 / TEL: / spaces / dots

id-prefix-reverse-and-identity.note: base '20230012', other 'S20230012' (prefix on the other side); s2: B/M/D prefixes that make different people out of the same digits

id-scientific-notation.note: the other file went through CSV: every 12-digit number became text like 2.02345E+11 (digits lost). Must never join on those

id-different-lengths.note: 8-digit 学籍番号 in the base, 6-digit (year without the century) in the others; s2 has no name to fall back on

phone-two-numbers.note: two numbers in one cell: "090-… / 03-…" and "090-…、080-…": the first valid number is the key

id-systems-overlap-by-accident.note: both files number their people 1001, 1002 … (different systems): the ID pairs different people, the names say so

email-shared-family-address.note: two people share one family address (p1, p11): that address decides nothing, everybody else joins through the e-mail

id-thousands-separator.note: IDs pasted with thousands separators as text: '20,230,012'

birthdate-notations.note: 生年月日 as 和暦 (H13.4.1 / 平成13年4月1日 / h13/04/01), 2001/4/1 text, serial numbers, 20010401, "2001年4月1日生"; two different 田中 太郎

paged-export-as-other.note: paged export: title, blank rows, the header repeated on every page, page markers "― 2 ―", subtotal rows in four notations, 合計; joined with "full"

paged-export-as-base.note: the BASE is the paged export: the repeated header / marker / subtotal rows must not become base rows

hidden-column-and-sheet.note: a hidden 内部ID column carries the key; a hidden sheet 旧データ is the first sheet of the workbook

two-row-merged-header.note: 「面接評価」 merged over 評価1/評価2/評価3; in A the key headers are merged over both rows, in B they are not

面接評価_結合ヘッダーB.xlsx

referral-columns.note: the other file has only 紹介者 (names of base people) and 紹介された人: a referrer is not the person of the row

bare-no-columns.note: 'No' columns are row counters of each file (1, 2, 3 …), never the same person across files; s2 has nothing else

no-person-key-at-all.note: other files have only categories (大学 / 学部 / 性別): joining people on those would fan one row out over many people

vertical-merged-university.note: 大学 merged over the rows of each group (only the first row carries the text); two 田中 太郎 need 氏名＋大学

remark-lines-inside-list.note: remark lines typed between the rows: "※ 以下は2次募集分", "---- 辞退者 ----"; joined with "full" (they must not become people)

list-in-two-pieces.note: the other file is one list in two pieces (5 blank rows between them): only the first piece is the table, the second is reported

form-template-example-row.note: the row under the header is a sample entry (例）山田 太郎): the real 山田 太郎 is NOT in this file and must not be joined to it

files.fileName: 応募フォーム_記入例付き.xlsx

typos-never-silent.note: every name is unique but 8 rows have a one-character typo: they must NOT be joined silently (suggestions); s2: typos in names but correct kana (joined via フリガナ, flagged), typos in kana only

namesakes-university.note: two different 田中 太郎 in the base (東京大学 / 早稲田大学). s1 has both with 大学 (order reversed), s2 has no 大学 (must stay ambiguous), s3 has one of them plus a third namesake

namesakes-same-university-faculty.note: two different 伊藤 翔: same 大学 and 学部, only the 生年月日 differs. s1 carries it, s2 does not (→ ambiguous, never guessed)

one-to-many-first.note: the base has one row per person, the other file 1–3 interview rows per person (policy first)

one-to-many-last.note: the base has one row per person, the other file 1–3 interview rows per person (policy last)

one-to-many-skip.note: the base has one row per person, the other file 1–3 interview rows per person (policy skip)

one-to-many-lookup-by-id.note: the BASE has several rows per person (応募履歴), the other file is a person master with one row each → VLOOKUP-style

one-to-many-name-only.note: base rows repeat the same name (3 of 10 people applied twice = 46% of the rows repeat) and there is no ID: a VLOOKUP-style join, reported as such

one-to-many-name-only-few.note: a person listed twice in the base without any ID: the two rows are ambiguous (flagged), everybody else joins

more-rows-than-base-full.note: the other file has 25 rows for a 10-person base: 10 known people, 12 new ones (3 of them twice), one new name without a space; joined with "full"

two-files-without-id-full.note: two files without an ID share only 氏名＋大学 (a 同姓同名 pair exists); joined with "full": s2 must find the rows s1 appended

every-file-keyed-differently.note: one base (ID/氏名/メール/電話), five files each keyed by something else: prefixed ID, 氏名+様, 大文字メール, 携帯, フリガナ
